The '''MT-16''' was a variant of the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] specially modified by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] for combat duty. It required a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and had room for one passenger. The MT-16 was armed with a single [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], and had a flight ceiling of two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].
